Mutual Confidentiality Agreement

Disclosing Party: Acme Robotics Inc.

Receiving Party: Northwind Manufacturing Inc.

Effective date: 2026-01-15

Purpose and Scope

Purpose: evaluate strategic manufacturing partnership

Confidential information includes technical designs, manufacturing plans, pricing, and partner diligence materials.

Obligations

Term: 3 years

Return or destroy materials within 10 business days after written request.

Legal Terms

Governing law: Delaware

Injunctive relief available for unauthorized disclosure or misuse of confidential information.
